data.narrative:
Akash Systems is a Series B-stage aerospace company that has raised $40M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of five public Space & Aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight private peers at similar or adjacent stages, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $40M total raised proxy, implying a $76M valuation. The peer-median method examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $1.1B (Skyryse, Series C) to $8.0B (Sierra Space, Series C), yielding a median valuation of $1.5B. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 23.9x P/S multiple cannot be applied without disclosed revenue.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $65M to $1.7B, with a median of $788M. This wide dispersion reflects material stage and maturity heterogeneity within the peer set, as well as uncertainty around Akash's operational traction and capital efficiency relative to later-stage comparables. The stage-progression floor assumes minimal premium to capital deployed, while the peer median is anchored by more mature Series C businesses. Resolution hinges on detailed revenue, growth trajectory, and competitive positioning relative to the identified peer set.
